subject: Please help test the upcoming Shiny release

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Please help test the upcoming Shiny release
parts:
Hi everyone -

We've been hard at work on a new release of Shiny. The upcoming version has many new features and bug fixes, and we would appreciate it if you could help us test it out before we make the official release, because we want to avoid introducing bugs that impact existing Shiny apps.

To install the development version, you first need the devtools package installed. Then restart R and run:
  devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny")

If you encounter any new bugs running your apps, please let us know by filing an issue in the Shiny issue tracker:
  https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues

Thanks for your help!
-Winston
